parked.spanish: Y tomará el sacerdote el cordero el uno, y lo acercará a culpa, y el log del aceite, y los balanceará balanceo delante de Jehová.

findings.issue: «acercará … a culpa» hace de culpa el destino. לְאָשָׁם deja abierta la preposición (a/para/como) y marca el papel del cordero, no un lugar.

parked.spanish: Y degollará el cordero en lugar que se degüella el pecado y el holocausto, en lugar de la santidad, porque como el pecado la culpa ella al sacerdote; santidad de santidades ella.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3ms active slaughter, with את marking the sin and the burnt offering as objects, is rendered passive/impersonal.
Locative 'in the place of the holiness' is rendered with the current-Spanish substitution idiom 'en lugar de' ('instead of the holiness').
Both pronouns are 3ms; 'ella' is feminine, matching Spanish 'culpa' rather than the masculine token.

parked.spanish: Y si pobre él, y no su mano alcanzante, y tomará cordero uno, culpa a balanceo para expiar sobre él, y décima sólet una amasada en el aceite a minjá, y log de aceite,

findings.issue: sólet dumps common noun H5560 untranslated; common nouns stay Spanish
minjá dumps common noun H4503 untranslated; common nouns stay Spanish
log leaves measure noun H3849 in Hebrew form; uncertain whether it is the conventional unit name or an untranslated lemma dump
amasada may narrow qal passive H1101 (mix/mingle) to kneading
feminine décima, una, and amasada smooth masculine singular morphology on the tenth, the cardinal, and the passive participle; number and participant stay singular

parked.spanish: Y desde el aceite derramará el sacerdote sobre palma del sacerdote la izquierda.

findings.issue: כַּף הַכֹּהֵן הַשְּׂמָאלִית is one definite construct, the priest’s left palm. “sobre palma … la izquierda” leaves palma without the article, so the phrase is harder to read as that single palm, without adding or dropping a participant.
findings.spanishSpan: sobre palma del sacerdote la izquierda

parked.spanish: Lo que alcanzare su mano, el uno pecado y el uno holocausto, sobre la minjá; y expiará el sacerdote sobre el que se purifica delante de Jehová.

findings.issue: חַטָּאת (lemma 2403 b, feminine singular noun) remains open between sin and sin-offering; pecado resolves it to abstract sin and drops the offering sense licensed in parallel with עֹלָה.
הַמִּנְחָה is a common noun, not a proper name; minjá leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.
עַל is only marked as a preposition (upon, over, concerning, in addition to); sobre narrows it toward a spatial on.

parked.spanish: Cuando entraren a tierra de Canaán que yo dando a ustedes a posesión, y daré plaga de tsaráat en casa de tierra de su posesión,

findings.issue: צָרַעַת is a common noun, not a proper name; tsaráat leaves the lemma untranslated instead of a Spanish common noun.
כִּי is tagged only as a conjunction; Cuando selects the temporal sense and closes because/if/that.
The ל on לַאֲחֻזָּה is rendered with the same a as the indirect object, so posesión can read as a second recipient rather than the possession for which the land is given.

parked.spanish: Y la casa raspará desde casa alrededor, y derramarán el polvo que rasparon a fuera a la ciudad, a lugar impuro.

findings.issue: את marks הַבַּיִת as the object of a 3ms hiphil imperfect. Spanish makes la casa the subject of raspará, so the house scrapes and the masculine singular actor is gone.
אֶל־מִחוּץ לָעִיר is one goal: outside, with the city as the ל complement of מִחוּץ. Spanish splits it into two destinations, a fuera and a la ciudad, and fuera does not express the מ preposition.
Both scrape verbs are hiphil. raspará and rasparon are simple active, so causative stem force is not shown.

parked.spanish: Y tomará para pecar la casa dos pájaros, y madera de erez y carmesí y ezov.

findings.issue: Piel infinitive with the house as direct object is rendered as “pecar”, the qal sense of committing sin, so the stem force on the house is changed.
Common noun ארז is left as the Hebrew form “erez” rather than Spanish.
The construct “scarlet of worm” is reduced to “carmesí”, and the worm noun is omitted.
Common noun אֵזֹב is left as the Hebrew form “ezov” rather than Spanish.

parked.spanish: Y pecará la casa en sangre del pájaro y en las aguas las vivas y en el pájaro la viva y en madera del erez y en el ezov y en el carmesí.

findings.issue: Piel sequential perfect 3ms takes the house as object (את); «pecará la casa» makes the house the subject of qal-force «sin», changing stem force and participant role.
Common noun H730 is left in Hebrew form «erez» instead of a Spanish common noun.
Common noun H231 is left in Hebrew form «ezov» instead of a Spanish common noun.
The construct noun plus the definite noun is reduced to one color word, so one licensed noun in the chain is omitted.
«la viva» keeps the feminine singular adjective but does not agree with masculine «pájaro», so the attributive link is unclear.
